title: Business Email Management
headline:
Real Business Email,
Quietly Handled.
shortDescription: Managed business email on your own domain — $10/mo per address. Setup, DNS (MX/SPF/DKIM/DMARC), spam protection, device configuration, and ongoing support included.
lead: Most trade businesses are still running yourname@gmail.com or busterspipes@yahoo.com. That's fine until a property manager prints your invoice next to a competitor whose email matches the truck — at which point you're losing the credibility war before the call even starts. We run real email on your own domain (you@yourbusiness.com) for $10/mo per mailbox. Setup, DNS, spam protection, device configuration, and ongoing support are all included — no separate Google or Microsoft invoices, no tab-juggling.
pricingCallout: $10/mo per mailbox · setup included · runs with or without a site

sections.heading: What's Included
sections.intro: $10 per mailbox per month covers everything below. Add or drop mailboxes any time — pro-rated monthly.

items.label: Mailbox on your domain
items.body: you@yourbusiness.com instead of a generic Gmail or Yahoo — billed per address

items.label: DNS records handled
items.body: MX, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC set up correctly so your email actually lands in inboxes

items.label: Spam & spoofing protection
items.body: Enterprise-grade filtering and anti-spoofing so scammers can't impersonate you to your customers

items.label: Mobile & desktop setup
items.body: We walk you through configuring phones, tablets, and laptops — or send a one-tap config profile

items.label: Aliases & forwarding
items.body: billing@, info@, dispatch@ forwarded to the right mailbox — no extra per-alias charge

items.label: Shared dispatch inbox (on request)
items.body: A single dispatch@ inbox that crew leads or office staff can read and respond from

items.label: Daily backups
items.body: Email stays recoverable if someone deletes something important

items.label: Ongoing support
items.body: Reset a password, add a new crew member, change a forwarding rule — same-day email response

sections.heading: Why This Matters
sections.body: Business email is one of the quiet things customers judge you on — and one of the most common places trade businesses leak credibility:
items: A yahoo.com or gmail.com address can feel less established to homeowners and property managers
DNS-misconfigured email goes to spam — you miss estimate requests and never know
Shared passwords and personal Gmails walk out the door when crew members do
SPF/DKIM/DMARC aren't optional anymore — Gmail and Yahoo both require them in 2026

items.label: $10/mo per mailbox
items.body: Real-person mailboxes only — aliases and forwards to existing mailboxes are free

items.label: No setup fee
items.body: Onboarding, DNS cutover, and device setup are included

items.label: Scales with the business
items.body: Add a mailbox when a new crew member joins, drop one when someone leaves — pro-rated monthly

items.label: Separate from your website plan
items.body: Bundled on one invoice if you have both, but priced independently

sections.heading: Perfect For
sections.intro: If any of these sound like you, business email on your own domain is the easiest credibility upgrade you'll make this year.

items.label: The Yahoo or Gmail holdout
items.body: You're sending estimate replies from busterspipes@yahoo.com and quietly losing inquiries from property managers who looked you up and weren't sure they had the right person.

items.label: Mismatched email and truck branding
items.body: Your truck wrap says "Apex Plumbing," but the email signature says "alex.smith.84@gmail.com." One of them is winning the credibility battle, and it's not the truck.

items.label: Burned by a transition
items.body: A crew lead left and walked out with the shared inbox password. You spent a week locking accounts, resetting things, and worrying about what they could still see.

items.label: Going from solo to multi-crew
items.body: Your business is moving from solo to multi-crew — and you want every crew lead's email address to match the business domain so customers see one cohesive brand.

items.label: Workspace setup quitter
items.body: You bought a Google Workspace seat, hit the DNS configuration wall, and the tab has been sitting open for three months. We pick it up where you left off.

faqs.question: Do I have to give up Gmail / Outlook?
faqs.answer: No. We can run mail on your own domain via our managed setup, OR keep your Gmail / Microsoft 365 mailboxes and just handle the DNS records (MX/SPF/DKIM/DMARC) so deliverability is correct. You pick the path on the intro call.

faqs.question: Is there a cap on how many mailboxes I can have?
faqs.answer: No hard cap. $10/mo per real-person mailbox; aliases and forwards to existing mailboxes are free. Add or drop mailboxes any time — pro-rated monthly.

faqs.question: How do I set this up on my devices?
faqs.answer: We send a one-tap config profile that drops the right server settings on iPhone or Android. Or, if you're a screen-share kind of person, we walk you through it on a quick call. Either way: it's working before we hang up.

faqs.question: Will my email actually land in inboxes — not the spam folder?
faqs.answer: Yes. We configure MX, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC correctly at setup and verify deliverability against Gmail and Yahoo. Both providers now require these records — most small businesses still don't have them right, which is why their replies land in spam.

faqs.question: Can I run email without buying a website plan?
faqs.answer: Yes. Email runs independently — billed per mailbox, no website required. You can add the website later, drop the website, or never have one. Email keeps working.

cta.heading: Want real business email without the hassle?
cta.body: $10/mo per address, all-in. Bundle it with your site or run it on its own.
